turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Data center demand accelerated further and AI adoption is broadening across enterprises. We are still supply constrained but adding capacity.
Revenue was $30.0 billion, up 122% year over year, another record. We expect data center investment to remain robust and raised our guidance.
How is HBM supply and pricing trending?
HBM supply is improving into next quarter and pricing power remains strong. Gross margin expanded to 76%.
